description: The Spanish Inventory of Dams and Reservoirs of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition (MITECO) covers the dams of all of Spain regardless of owner and serves as the ministry's tool for checking compliance with dam safety rules. For each dam it gives a technical sheet, name, river basin district, dam code, watercourse and basin, municipality and province, and the inventory describes dam type, geometric and geographic characteristics, basin and reservoir features, uses, and the status of the documents required by the dam safety standards: hazard classification, operating rules and emergency plans. It is shown in the viewer of the national flood zone mapping system (SNCZI) and published as INSPIRE hydrography and an EU high-value dataset through WMS, OGC API Features, an ATOM feed and a zipped layer download, free under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to MITECO; the metadata were last revised in December 2025. Caveats: the download holds the geographic layer and some safety-document details may only be visible in the viewer, fields were not inspected because no file was downloaded, and one metadata constraint cites an INSPIRE public access limitation. Simulation uses: a complete national dam inventory for dam-break and flood exposure modelling, linking reservoirs to irrigation, water supply and hydropower, prioritising dams without emergency plans, and emergency planning downstream. Related records: the Swiss dams under federal supervision (data-switzerland-dams-under-federal-supervision) and the ICOLD World Register of Dams (data-icold-world-register-of-dams).
